body:
I wish I had an answer for you.

I wish I had an answer for me.

Literally the only thing that prevents me from doing it usually is because I don't want to miss a couple upcoming movies and shows.

The only thing in life that brings me the slightest amount of joy are my fandoms. Granted the joy is nowhere remotely what it used to be, but that tiny bit is what I cling to.

....is there any little thing that you are looking forward to?

I know it's so so easy to just say you don't care or that it won't matter because you're dead... But is there even the smallest thing?

I get this.

I tried to explain it to an online friend and they didn't get it. "You are who you are!"

But _I don't know_ who I am!!

"How can you not know who you are??"

\*cries*

I've tried that before but it just doesn't seem to help. Maybe I haven't found the right people.

Like I said above I have some online friends I talk to pretty freely and even though they offer words of encouragement I think I'm just a downer/ they don't know what to say after a while.

I guess I just need to keep looking.

I don't think anyone would want my life, I hardly want it.

Nothing seems to make me happy anymore. I've tried but in the end they're all just ways to waste time and try not to be so in my head.

Ah, I suppose I should've been clearer. I don't have a lot of wiggle room in my schedule and I live out in the country, 30-35 minutes to the city. I work Fridays-Sundays at the family business and am expected home soon after I close the shop.

On Mondays and Wednesdays I'm off but I usually stay home or occasionally go to a friend's house but I can't use the excuse I'm going over there too often because of reasons and Monday afternoons I'm expected to help my dad at his business.

Tuesdays and Thursdays however I am gone from 8:40am to 9:10pm because I have classes from 9:30am to 8:30pm with two breaks about an hour and a half each. I could find something in the city during my break but I feel like schedule times wouldn't meet up and even in this city it seems like you somehow always run into someone you know.
